text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a hard-working freelancer with 7 years of experience and a strong background in building reliable web systems.

I’d be glad to help source video links for your reaction channel. I understand you need a few hundred clips across the kinds of content you listed, including street fights, influencer fights, Jiu-Jitsu matches, training footage, and examples of both bad and fake martial arts. I’m comfortable handling detailed, repetitive research work like this and organizing the results clearly so you can review and use them quickly.

In a past project, I built a staff onboarding portal for healthcare staffing where nurses uploaded credentials and managers approved them with region-based permissions. That portal supported 2,400 staff and helped reduce onboarding paperwork from 5 days to 1 day. While that project was more technical, it reflects the same strengths I’d bring here: careful organization, consistency, and the ability to work through a large volume of items accurately.

I also bring extensive experience with full stack work and modern web technologies, including JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I mention this because I’m used to working methodically, following requirements closely, and delivering clean, usable output.

For your project, I’d focus on finding links that match your categories and keeping the results easy to sort and reference. I can work through the search process efficiently and make sure the content is relevant to what you want to react to.

I’d be happy to discuss how you’d like the links organized and how many you’d like in each category.
